text: Host monitoringHost monitoring is not available in this version of AgEnD.Monitor this computerWhen on, samples every 30–60 seconds; estimated 2–4 MiB RAM and 1–4 MiB of local writes per hour.Include agent footprintOptional process snapshot every minute; for 32 agents, an estimated extra 2–8 MiB RAM and 1–4 MiB of writes per hour.Off by default. While off, there is no monitoring collector, timer or history file.
主機監測這個 AgEnD 版本尚未提供主機監測。監測這台電腦開啟後每 30–60 秒取樣；估計使用 2–4 MiB 記憶體，每小時本機寫入 1–4 MiB。包含 Agent 資源用量選用：每分鐘讀取行程資料；32 個 Agent 估計另用 2–8 MiB 記憶體，每小時寫入 1–4 MiB。預設關閉。關閉時沒有監測收集器、計時器或歷史檔案。
